name: com.streethawk.library.CrashReportingService
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this Service to monitor uncaught crashes and send saved crash reports when a network connection is available. When a crash occurs, it records app and device details, then passes the error to the app's existing crash handler.
disableEffect: StreetHawk crash reports will no longer be collected or uploaded.
